name: text-probes
description: Short random-string prompts for a Hamming-kernel MMD (Model Equality Testing style).

prompts.prompt: Output a random 8-character lowercase hex string and nothing else.
Generate a random integer between 1 and 1000000 and nothing else.
Write one random English word that starts with the letter q.
Output a random 12-character alphanumeric password and nothing else.
Generate a random UUID version 4 and nothing else.
Write the first three digits that come to mind and nothing else.
Output a random color name and nothing else.
Give one random European capital city and nothing else.
Generate a random 6-letter nonsense word.
Output a random date in 2031 in ISO format and nothing else.
Write a random four-word phrase made of unrelated nouns.
Output a random prime number below 500 and nothing else.
Generate a random hexadecimal color code and nothing else.
Write a random animal name and nothing else.
Output ten random bits as a string of 0 and 1 and nothing else.
Generate a random two-letter country code and nothing else.
Write a random weekday and a random month separated by a comma.
Output a random sentence of exactly five words.
Generate a random IPv4 address and nothing else.
Write a random single-letter variable name and nothing else.
